sources.title: AI Email Formatter
sources.snippet: AI Email Formatter Paste your email text below and optionally add custom instructions. The AI will format your email with HTML elements for lists, tables, and more. Copy and paste the result directly into Outlook, Gmail, or any email client.

sources.title: AI Email Writer: Write Professional Emails with AI (Free) - Mailmeteor
sources.snippet: The fastest way to generate email with AI AI Email Writer by Mailmeteor makes it easy to generate fine-tuned emails, thanks to GPT models. Using a large language model (LLM), it will generate email content based on the context and intent expressed in your instructions.
